artworks.title: Louis, Chevalier de Toussard
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in profile, facing right, with distinct facial features and curly hair. He wears a formal military uniform with epaulettes and a high-collared jacket. The man is surrounded by a decorative circular frame with classical motifs and military symbols, including cannons and crests. The background and layout resemble a classic engraving style.

artworks.title: Mosque of Sultan Bayazid, Constantinople
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an architectural interior with vaulted ceilings and columned walls. The image features a high archway with detailed stonework and geometric patterns on the ceiling. There are tall, slender windows on the walls, and light is filtering into the space, creating shadows on the floor. The drawing depicts a grand and symmetrical atmosphere, reminiscent of gothic or medieval architecture. Crosshatching and shading techniques are used to add depth and texture to the stone surfaces.

artworks.title: Alexander de Medicis and Cosmo de Medicis
artworks.description: The image shows two angelic figures in an ornate illustration. They are standing upright with one arm extended to hold a crown. The central figure has detailed facial features, flowing hair with a crown of leaves, draped garments, and large wings. Two circular portrait medallions on each side feature men with distinct facial features. Below the figures, a lion with a shield is depicted, along with various ensigns and drapery. The background shows a detailed landscape with architectural elements and a clear sky.

artworks.title: Emperor Maximilian II
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 20.9 x 15.5 cm (8 1/4 x 6 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a man with a long, pointed nose, deep-set eyes, and a bushy mustache and beard. He wears a tall hat with a decorative band and feathers, a lace ruff, and an ornate collar chain. In the background, there is a curtain with a pattern and a view of distant buildings and a spire under a clear sky. The image includes inscriptions in Latin text at the bottom.

artworks.title: A Little Brook in Winter, Wiltshire
artworks.description: The image displays a narrow path or alley enclosed by a rustic building on the left and bare trees on the right. The horizon is obscured by the building and trees, giving no distinctive features in the distance. The drawing is characterized by fine lines and sketchy brushstrokes, creating an impressionistic appearance. The color scheme is primarily sepia, evoking a nostalgic ambiance. Dark shadows and detailed markings hint at foliage near the path, while sparse branches and twigs adorn the sky, enhancing the rustic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Nude Figure Lying Down
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 10.1 × 14.9 cm (4 × 5 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a nude woman lying face down on a textured surface, with her entire body shown from head to toe. Her upper body is propped up on her elbows, causing her back to arch slightly. She faces away from the viewer, with dark hair styled in a bun at the nape of her neck. The etching emphasizes the contours and muscles of her body. The background features abstract, dark linear patterns contrasting with the lighter skin tone and the surface she lies upon. The composition is in a monochrome palette with warm tones.

artworks.title: Figure of a Woman Crouching
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 17.6 × 12.7 cm (6 15/16 × 5 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of a woman sitting with her knees drawn up to her chest on a fabric-covered surface. She has a serene expression, closed eyes, and her hair styled in an updo. The woman is nude, with light and shade emphasizing her form. The background is a dimly lit space with draped fabric, shadows, and a soft light source coming from the left.

artworks.title: October Evening
artworks.description: The image features a tree with branches extending widely across the canvas. The view is from a slightly lower angle, emphasizing the tree's prominence. The horizon is obscured by dense foliage, blending into suggestions of other trees and land. The brushstrokes are stippled, creating a textured effect. The color palette is dark, mainly blacks and browns. The tree bark and undergrowth are textured, contributing to a thick setting. Lighter tones are absent, enhancing the somber mood.

artworks.title: Marshlands
artworks.description: The image shows a dark, moody landscape with a tree on the right side. The view is from ground level towards a shadowy expanse. The horizon is not visible due to dense trees and foliage. The brushstrokes are textured, creating a heavy and deep appearance. The color palette is monochromatic, with dark blacks and browns, giving the image a somber atmosphere.

artworks.title: The Art Student
artworks.medium: drypoint and softground etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 7.6 × 2.4 cm (3 × 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows an artistic sketch of the upper half of a woman's body in profile view. The woman's face, shoulders, and loose bun hairstyle are visible. She is wearing a garment that covers her shoulders. The background is filled with abstract lines and scribbles.

artworks.title: Ships at Fowey
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 9.8 × 6.6 cm (3 7/8 × 2 5/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows three masted ships anchored next to each other on calm waters with trees and foliage framing the scene. The etching is intricate with fine, cross-hatched lines detailing the ships, rigging, and natural elements. The color palette is warm and neutral, primarily sepia tones. A small boat with two figures can be seen near the trees.

artworks.title: Portrait of Dr. Bilderbeck Gomess
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 9.9 × 8.4 cm (3 7/8 × 3 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a portrait showing the upper half of a person's body in profile view, facing the left side. The person is seated and appears to be sitting upright. The facial features are delicately sketched with a soft, contemplative expression. The hair is dark and wavy, parted at the side, and styled neatly. The person is wearing a high-collared garment, possibly a coat or cape, without any visible buttons or embellishments. There are no visible items of jewelry or objects being held by the person. The background is plain with subtle textures.

artworks.title: Une Apache
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 8 × 8.5 cm (3 1/8 × 3 3/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up portrait of a seated individual from the chest upwards. The person is slightly turned to the left, with their head angled downwards, casting a shadow across their face. Their features include dark, expressive eyes and a closed-lipped expression. The shoulder-length, wavy hair is dark and merges with the background. The person wears a light-colored garment and is set against a dark, textured background. The style appears to be an etching or print, with shading and lines adding depth to the portrait.

artworks.title: Portrait of Mrs. Arthur Melville
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 22.7 × 17.7 cm (8 15/16 × 6 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman seated from the waist up. She is slightly turned to her right, with her left arm resting on the chair's arm. Her facial features are soft, with dark hair pulled back. She wears a simple dress with short puffed sleeves and a collar, and a pendant around her neck. In the background, there are ceramic or glass vessels on a shelf, with textured fabric suggesting curtains or tapestries. The artwork focuses on the woman's delicate lines and shading in a dimly lit interior.

artworks.title: A Baby
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 12.7 × 10.1 cm (5 × 4 in.)
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a child's face. The upper body is suggested by faint clothing lines. The child is facing slightly left with a gentle expression. The child is wearing a bonnet or head covering. The clothing appears warm with suggested collar lines. There are no visible accessories or objects. The background is plain.

artworks.title: Moonrise from the River
artworks.medium: softground etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 5.6 × 9.8 cm (2 3/16 × 3 7/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a low horizon featuring dense foliage. An orb is visible slightly to the right above the horizon. The sky blends with the land in a tranquil gradient. The painting style is delicate with sparse brushstrokes. The color palette is limited to shades of gray and brown, creating a subdued and contemplative atmosphere suggestive of dusk or twilight.

artworks.title: Monaco from La Condamine, Monte Carlo
artworks.description: The image depicts a coastal scene with buildings on a rocky hill, a subtle horizon line where the sea meets the sky, clouds overhead, intricate lines defining the landscape and buildings, a monochrome color palette of black and white, boats on the water, and a person rowing a boat.

artworks.title: Portrait of Miss Hetty Pettigrew
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 26.3 × 14.8 cm (10 3/8 × 5 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a woman from the waist up, standing and facing forward. She has soft facial features, curly medium-length hair under a hat, and is wearing a dress with an off-the-shoulder collar, a large bow, and a belt at the waist. The background is textured gray with no other objects.

artworks.title: The Alcove
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 12.6 × 17.3 cm (4 15/16 × 6 13/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image features a full-body view of a person in a side position facing the right. The person is seated with legs extended in front, arms raised near or touching the head. The individual has dark hair, and facial features are somewhat subtle due to the stylized artwork. The figure is nude without any visible accessories or items. The background is textured and dark, with soft strokes hinting at a curtain or drapery.

artworks.title: The Terrace, Monte Carlo, End of Afternoon, April 1905
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 15.1 × 23.6 cm (5 15/16 × 9 5/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a viewpoint by the water with people walking and talking on a promenade. There are elegantly dressed individuals, including a woman in a long dress and hat, engaging in conversation. Ornate street lamps frame the scene on both sides. The horizon divides the sea from distant land covered in dark foliage. Mountains rise in the background under a sky with soft clouds. The artwork has a monochromatic palette, and delicate linework creates a serene atmosphere. The scene is softly focused.

artworks.title: Corner of Luna Street, Chelsea Embankment
artworks.medium: etching in green on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 16.4 × 14.2 cm (6 7/16 × 5 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of people near a fence with ships' masts in the background. The scene appears to be near a harbor. The artwork uses fine lines to depict texture and movement. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of deep blue-green. A tree is depicted among the figures and ship masts, with its leaves rendered in short, sweeping strokes.

artworks.title: Corner of Luna Street, Chelsea Embankment
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 16.3 × 14.2 cm (6 7/16 × 5 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a busy street scene with various figures and structures. The horizon is blocked by buildings and ship masts. Tall ships with large masts are prominent. The etching features detailed, sketchy lines for texture. The color scheme is monochromatic. A tree with textured leaves is in the foreground, with people in period attire. Figures interact, creating a lively atmosphere. Ships' masts are visible in the distance, hinting at a harbor setting.

artworks.title: Parson's Green, Afternoon, End of Winter, The Duke's Head
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to platemark): 18.7 × 22.2 cm (7 3/8 × 8 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a street scene with a central building, benches, a fence, and trees. The central building appears to have intricate architectural details. The scene includes people, horse-drawn carriages, and clouds in the sky. The artwork is created using detailed etching techniques with fine lines, providing texture. The color palette is monochromatic in varying shades of sepia or light brown, giving an aged look.

artworks.title: The Children's Hour, Summer Evening, Parson's Green
artworks.dimensions: plate (cut to plate mark): 8.3 × 5.1 cm (3 1/4 × 2 in.)
artworks.description: The image shows a park scene with a lamppost, figures sitting on a bench or barrier, and people walking in the distance. Trees fill the background with intricate patterns created by their branches, blending with the foliage-covered horizon. The artwork is an etching with fine lines and cross-hatching to depict textures and shadows, in monochromatic tones of gray and black, giving a calm and detailed visual impression.
